caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a wall-mounted urinal. The urinal has a semi-circular bowl shape with a prominent rim and an angled back. The exterior surface is colored a mottled green, indicating a possible marble or stone texture, while the interior is shaded in off-white or pale beige tones, suggesting a porcelain or ceramic surface. There is a subtle use of shadow beneath and to the right of the object, indicating the direction of light. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing all attention on the urinal. The lower right corner of the drawing contains a signature, “W.J. Goodacre.”
title: Holy Water Font, Santa Barbara
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
